title: North Lake Tahoe Boat Rental
specs: Morning rentals offer calmer water and lower prices
Luxury wakesurf boat with patented Switch Surf system and supercharged engine
Renters must be over 21 years old
Valid driver's license required matching card on file
Captain must have valid MMC, 2 years Tahoe employment, CPR/First Aid
Maximum 13 people per bareboat charter (12 passengers plus driver)
Pontoon rentals limited to northern half of lake only
